name: NPC Students Internship Program
benefit:
> **Certificate** The interns will be issued an internship completion certificate upon successful completion and submission of the full project report.
> **Logistics & Support** NPC shall provide them with working space with an internet facility and other necessities as deemed fit by the concerned reporting authorities. **NOTE:** The Interns will be required to bring their own laptops.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India. 1. The applicant should not already have applied for the internship before in the current financial year. 1. The applicant should be a student pursuing graduation and post-graduation studies.
##### Only for Interns in Information Technology (IT) > **Job Requirements** 1. Strong editing, written and oral communication skills. 1. Strong interpersonal skills. 1. Proactive technical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. 1. Knowledge and understanding of learning patterns and strong Research and networking for generating quality learning material. 1. Knowledge of current and emerging eLearning tools and applications. 1. Expertise in graphics creation for classroom-based training, online training, and websites. > **Desired Skills** 1. Proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite (i.e. Word, Excel, Powerpoint, Outlook), Adobe Photoshop and/or Adobe In Design 1. Proficient in graphic designing tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Corel Draw, Illustrator, Ink Shape & related software knowledge 1. Proficient in programming, data/ content management, and website development with Java, .NET, JavaScript or HTML/DHTML. 1. The overall work may also include leveraging leading technologies like SAS, Big Data, Hadoop, Hive, Pig, Python, SQL, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Data Annotation Services.
